scope: Full Wantiss production backup and restoration; synthetic local recovery is separate.
cliAuthenticationCheck: No access token supplied; official browser sign-in started and awaits owner verification.
remainingPrerequisite: Complete the official CLI login so supported backup/connection capabilities can be inspected; do not send a password or API key in chat.
restoreEnvironmentRequirement: The actual backup must restore pg_cron, pg_net and supabase_vault with supported binaries; local stub schemas are not acceptable full-production recovery evidence. Restore only in a network-isolated local environment with scheduled jobs disabled.
